svg.desc: A prediction request is validated against the schema (422 on failure), checked for batch size (413), checked for a loaded model (503), then scored and answered with 200 plus the model version.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every rejection happens before any model code runs.
